_comment: Terrain rules table, SPEC.md §3. Global, not per-map: map.json references these ids. moveCost null means impassable. cover is none | light | heavy. tracks (M57, SPEC.md §9 Tracks), when true: a man stepping onto it leaves prints, where the mission has tracks. landing (SPEC.md §9), when present: bad costs a man landing there his first turn, wounds wounds him and puts him ashore on the nearest bank. All balance numbers live here, never in logic (CLAUDE.md rule 5).

canal.label: Canal
canal.notes: crossable only at bridge or lock

bridge.label: Bridge
bridge.notes: canal crossing; not in the SPEC §3 table, added at M1 so §3's crossable only at bridge/lock is expressible

lock.label: Lock
lock.notes: canal crossing on foot; same addition as bridge

depot.label: Fuel dump
depot.notes: drums, tanks and tarpaulins; the fuel dump objective stands on it (SPEC.md §7). Not in the §3 table: added at M5b

scrub.label: Scrub
scrub.notes: camel-thorn: light cover you can be seen in

dunes.label: Dunes
dunes.notes: soft sand; a crest hides what lies beyond it

wadi.label: Wadi
wadi.notes: a dry watercourse below the ground: the safe artery; rocks make a bad landing

wire.label: Wire
wire.notes: the perimeter wire: a full turn for a sapper to get through

pen.label: Pen
pen.notes: earth and sandbag walls round an aircraft; its charge point stands in it

aircraft.label: Aircraft
aircraft.notes: a parked aircraft; the objective stands on it

hillside.label: Hillside
hillside.notes: bare winter slope: slow, and seen (SPEC.md §14, M41)

crag.label: Crag
crag.notes: rock faces that shape the valleys

ravine.label: Ravine
ravine.notes: the torrent's bed: the safe artery; rocks and water make a bad landing

terrace.label: Terrace
terrace.notes: stone-walled terraces, as hedgerows are in France

plough.label: Plough
plough.notes: open winter fields: fast, exposed, soft landings

aqueduct.label: Aqueduct
aqueduct.notes: the channel on its piers; the objective stands on it

arch.label: Pier foot
arch.notes: the dressed stone at the foot of the aqueduct's piers; its charge points

rocks.label: Shore rocks
rocks.notes: where men lie up for the boat

sea.label: Sea
sea.notes: no swim; nothing lands in it

snowfield.label: Snowfield
snowfield.notes: the open plateau (MISSION-GUNNERSIDE.md): fast, seen, and it keeps your trail. M57: in the table for the tracks rule; no map uses it until M58

drift.label: Drift
drift.notes: deep snow: slow, and still leaves a trail. M57: as the snowfield

pines.label: Pine wood
pines.notes: the safe artery on the plateau: the trees hold the snow off, so no prints (MISSION-GUNNERSIDE.md, M58)

rock.label: Rock
rock.notes: outcrops: a crest hides what lies beyond

gorgeSide.label: Gorge side
gorgeSide.notes: a cliff down into the gorge. 30 is more than any pool, so a man climbs it only with the step every man has at full AP (rules.json minimumStep) and it takes his whole turn; and so dear that the garrison always paths round by the bridge (the operator's, M58: a whole turn, never 3 AP)

ice.label: Ice
ice.notes: the frozen river at the gorge's bottom: seen only from beside it

railway.label: Railway
railway.notes: the line along the shelf to the plant: swept, fast, open, no prints

hall.label: Hall
hall.notes: inside the cell hall; its charge points are here

duct.label: Cable duct
duct.notes: the quiet way into the hall

cells.label: Cells
cells.notes: the electrolysis cells; the objective stands on them

pipes.label: Pipes
pipes.notes: the penstocks down the hillside behind the plant

barracks.label: Barracks
barracks.notes: the garrison's huts on the shelf
